deviations_from_card: Brain's grammar and transcriptRoute/floorRoute live in apps/console/src/router/brain.ts (+ router/brain.test.ts), not pages/brain/routes.ts(+test): the repo's eslint boundaries forbid page->page and shell->page imports, so a cross-page link builder cannot live in a page folder. The rise-parity and crumb acceptance cases live in the new shell/subroute.dom.test.tsx (shell may import router, not page). Schema marker is `inPlace` (segment does not count toward the rise) rather than a `rise` flag; same semantics. Coupled files beyond the write set: router/brain.ts, router/brain.test.ts, shell/subroute.dom.test.tsx, pages/onair/transcriptLinks.dom.test.tsx, pages/brain/layer2.test.tsx (brainLabel test -> schemaLabel), pages/characters/layer2.test.tsx (evidence links now qualified with the tournament), budgets/bundle.json (lock taken). Characters SituationsTab now qualifies with its tid (the refs come from that tournament's results); Reconcile and Simulator refs carry no tournament and stay bare unless the ref is already qualified. Brain-internal call sites (Runs.tsx, Viewer.tsx, brain/Layer1.tsx, PreflightLamp.tsx) were outside the write set and still use pageRoute; Layer1 onair's PREFLIGHT_BOARD moved to floorRoute.
notes: Entry budget raised 286,000 -> 288,000 (measured 285,947 -> 287,225 B, all of it this change: schema matcher, brain grammar, shell derivations; confirmed in a clean scratch worktree at HEAD+my diff) in its own commit e9187c4 with a $comment sentence. During the build the whole console suite was intermittently red (timeouts, 14-181 failures) from contract-package A's in-flight data-door edits; verified in a clean scratch worktree (488 passed) and then on main after a4bf2ab landed: all four gates rc=0 at 0ed60af's tree. RISE_DEPTH keeps its brain entry as the parity fallback; other pages migrate by declaring routes. Shell.tsx change is small (labeller + fallback effect + riseKey arg) for console-shell-router B's later wave.
